# Sattva Constructions – Authorised Channel Partner, Sattva Group

> Sattva Constructions is an authorised channel partner of Sattva Group, one of India's foremost real estate conglomerates. This website is the official channel partner microsite for Sattva Springs — an ultra-luxury gated villa community on Kanakapura Road, South Bangalore. We are not the developer or promoter. All pricing and project details are as provided by Sattva Group and are subject to change.

## About This Site

This microsite exists to help prospective buyers discover, evaluate, and enquire about Sattva Springs villas. It provides complete project information including configurations, pricing, amenities, floor plans, location advantages, and RERA details. Leads are handled by our advisory team, not routed through a call centre.

## The Project — Sattva Springs

- **Developer:** Sattva Group (est. 1993), Bengaluru
- **Project Type:** Ultra-luxury gated villa community
- **Configuration:** 4 BHK Row Villas (Triplex — Basement + Ground + 2 Floors + Private Terrace)
- **Total Villas:** 66 villas across 5.5 acres
- **Location:** 129 Kanakapura Road, Badamanavarathekaval, Bengaluru 560082 (opposite Art of Living International Centre)
- **RERA Registration:** PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/240724/006948 (Karnataka RERA — verifiable at karerait.karnataka.gov.in)
- **Possession:** September 2027 (construction ~50% complete as of mid-2026, on schedule)
- **Price Range:** ₹4.79 Cr – ₹7.00 Cr (all-inclusive)

## Key Amenities (30+)

Swimming Pool, Gymnasium, Yoga & Meditation Deck, Jogging Track, Cycling Track, Cricket Pitch, Badminton Court, Multipurpose Sports Court, Skating Rink, Kids Pool, Grand Clubhouse, Party Hall & Banquet, Amphitheatre, Games Room, Co-working Lounge, Landscaped Gardens, Tree-lined Avenue, Children's Play Area, Pet Park, Outdoor Seating Gazebos, 24×7 Security with CCTV, DG Power Backup (common areas), Dedicated Basement Parking per Villa.

## Location Advantages

- Art of Living International Centre: 2.2 km
- Dayananda Sagar Academy: 1 km
- NICE Ring Road: 5 km
- Silk Institute Metro (Green Line): 6 km
- JP Nagar / Jayanagar: 25–30 min
- Electronic City via NICE Road: 35–40 min

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Sattva Springs RERA registered?**
Yes. Karnataka RERA number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/240724/006948. Verifiable at karerait.karnataka.gov.in.

**What configurations are available?**
Types A, B, D, E, and F are open for booking. Only Type C is fully subscribed.

**What is the price of a villa at Sattva Springs?**
All-inclusive prices range from ₹4.79 Cr (Type A, 3,607 sq ft) to ₹7.00 Cr (Type F, 5,236 sq ft).

**When is possession?**
RERA-scheduled possession: September 2027. Construction is approximately 50% complete as of mid-2026.

**Is there any extra cost when buying through a channel partner?**
No. We offer the same pricing as the developer. Buyers pay nothing extra and receive personalised advisory, documentation support, home loan facilitation, and post-booking service.

**What banks offer home loans for Sattva Springs?**
The project is approved by all leading banks including SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, and Kotak. Loan assistance is provided at no cost.
